new_value: cur_skip_item now rejects map arguments > UINT64_MAX/2 before the *2 doubling (would wrap to 0, making the container look empty and realigning the parse on untrusted unknown-key values). Regression test test_skip_item_rejects_wrapping_map_argument: a body whose unknown-key value is map(2^63) followed by a valid interval_ms key must be rejected atomically (pre-fix it was accepted with the trailing key honored).
